summary: JSON and NDJSON format: JsonSpec options (property path, item shape and keys, array header row, ndjson, temporal handling, inference sample size), a polars fast path for record arrays and NDJSON objects, stdlib decoding for everything else, a line-bounded NDJSON schema inspector and a serialiser.
lifecycle_notes: The .ndjson and .jsonl suffixes set ndjson=True through suffix_overrides.
Payloads that are not tabular (scalars, mixed shapes) come back as Python objects; the output seam rejects arrays that are not records.
documentation_hooks: JSON shapes: documents, record arrays, array rows with header, NDJSON
risks: json_serialise uses default=str, which silently turns non-JSON values into strings.
